task: Search Allrecipes for a baked lemon chicken recipe that has a prep time under 45 minutes, with at least a 4.5-star rating based on user reviews, and over 200 reviews. List the primary ingredients required.
answer: Found a qualifying baked lemon chicken recipe on Allrecipes: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potato Bake (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/242402/greek-lemon-chicken-and-potato-bake/). It is rated 4.6 stars from 895 ratings (693 reviews), exceeding the 4.5-star and 200-review thresholds, and has a 10-minute prep time (under 45 minutes). The search results page had no dedicated prep-time/rating filter controls, so constraints were verified directly from the recipe page content. Primary ingredients: 6 skin-on, bone-in chicken leg quarters; 2 pounds red potatoes (cut into wedges); 1/3 cup olive oil; 2 lemons; 2 teaspoons dried basil; 1 teaspoon dried oregano; 1 teaspoon salt; 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper; 1/2 teaspoon lemon pepper seasoning; 1 pound fresh green beans (trimmed).

## Conclusion
